/* isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper - selectTrprInfo */ /* Lee SangHoon[설문내용 대상자정보 조회] */
SELECT
T5.BIZ_YR -- 사업연도 ,T4.INST_NO -- 기관번호 ,T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO -- 서비스실행사업번호 ,T.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 배정그룹소분류구분코드 ,DEC_B64(NVL(T2.FLNM_ENCPT, T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명암호화 ,NVL(T2.SXDC_SE_CD, T1.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.ACBG_SE_CD) AS ACBG -- 학력 ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T3.GRADE_SE_CD) AS GRADE -- 학년 ,NVL(T2.BRTH_YMD, T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) AS BRDT -- 생년월일 ,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, NVL(T2.BRTH_YMD, T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD))/12,0) AS AGEA -- 만나이
FROM SBB600 T /* 설문발송이력 */ LEFT JOIN SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ ON T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 T2 /* 개인정보 */ ON T2.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A LEFT JOIN SAC100 B ON CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) T3 /* 학력상태 */ ON T3.RN = 1 AND T3.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SDA420 T4 /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T5 /* 서비스사업 */ ON T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_BIZ_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND T.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} -- 기관번호 AND T.REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} -- 등록일자 AND T.MNG_SN = #{MNG_SN} -- 관리일련번호

/* isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper - selectSrvyRspnsInfo */ /* Lee SangHoon[설문내용 설문응답정보 조회] */
SELECT
T.TRPR_REL_SE_CD -- 대상자와의관계 ,DEC_B64(T.SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT) AS SRVY_RSPDNT_NM -- 설문응답자명암호화 ,CASE T.TRPR_REL_SE_CD WHEN '11' THEN T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD WHEN '12' THEN T1.PRTCR_BRTH_YMD END AS BRDT -- 생년월일 ,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, CASE T.TRPR_REL_SE_CD WHEN '11' THEN T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD WHEN '12' THEN T1.PRTCR_BRTH_YMD END)/12,0) AS AGEA -- 만나이 ,T5.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM AS QUSTNB_KND -- 설문지종류 ,T.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD -- 설문시기 ,T.SNDNG_DT AS SRVY_SNDNG_DT -- 설문발송일 ,T4.RSPNS_DT AS SRVY_RSPNS_DT -- 설문응답일 ,(SELECT SUM(GRDNG_SCORE) FROM SBB510 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = T4.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = T4.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = T4.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) AS SRVY_SCORE -- 설문점수
,T.QUSTNB_MNG_NO -- 설문지관리번호 ,T.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO -- 설문지템플릿관리번호
FROM SBB600 T /* 설문발송이력 */ LEFT JOIN SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ ON T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN AFA100 T2 /* 신청접수 */ ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.APLY_RCPT_SN = T.APLY_RCPT_SN LEFT JOIN SBB500 T4 /* 설문응답 */ ON T4.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = T.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND T4.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = T.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND T4.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = T.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) LEFT JOIN SBB000 T5 /* 설문지템플릿 */ ON T5.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = T.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND T.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} -- 기관번호 AND T.REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} -- 등록일자 AND T.MNG_SN = #{MNG_SN} -- 관리일련번호

/* isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper - selectSrvyTrprCount */ /* Lee SeoungJae[사전/사후 작성자 수 조회] */
SELECT COUNT( CASE WHEN D.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 END) AS BEFFAT_WRTR_COUNT --사전작성자수 , COUNT( CASE WHEN D.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 END) AS AFTFCT_WRTR_COUNT --사후작성자수
FROM ( SELECT SRVY_ERA_SE_CD , QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , INST_NO , SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT , trpr_info_no , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INST_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO, QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, SRVY_ERA_SE_CD ORDER BY REG_YMD DESC, MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SBB600 )D /*설문발송이력 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SBB500 C /*설문응답 테이블*/ ON D.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 AND D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 AND C.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO)
WHERE D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} --단위업무구분코드 AND D.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' --기관구분코드 AND D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' --서비스실행사업번호 AND D.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD LIKE #{SRVY_ERA_SE_CD} || '%' --설문시기구분코드 AND D.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN ( --설문지템플릿관리번호 (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 --추가관리값1 FROM SAC100 /*공통코드 테이블*/ WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' --공통코드아이디 = 설문지종류구분코드 AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE= #{QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD} --공통코드 값 ), (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 --추가관리값1 FROM SAC100 /*공통코드 테이블*/ WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' --공통코드아이디 = 설문지종류구분코드 AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE= #{QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD}) --공통코드 값 ) AND TO_CHAR(C.RSPNS_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} --응답일시
AND D.SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{SRVY_RSPDNT_NM}) --설문응답자명암호화
AND D.RN = 1

/* isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper - selectSrvyAnlsCn */ /* Lee SeoungJae[설문내용 분석내용 조회] */
WITH TEMP1 AS ( SELECT C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM --설문지채점영역명 , MAX((CASE WHEN A.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' THEN ROUND(D.GRDNG_SCORE,2) END)) AS BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG --사전설문점수 , MAX((CASE WHEN A.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' THEN ROUND(D.GRDNG_SCORE,2) END)) AS AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG --사후설문점수 ,D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --설문지채점영역관리번호
FROM SBB600 A /*설문발송이력 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SBB500 B /*설문응답 테이블*/ ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 AND B.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) INNER JOIN SBB130 C /*채점영역설정 테이블*/ ON C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿 관리번호 INNER JOIN SBB510 D /*채점결과 테이블*/ ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 AND B.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO --설문응답관리번호 AND C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --설문지채점영역관리번호
WHERE A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} --기관번호 AND A.REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} --등록일자 AND A.MNG_SN = #{MNG_SN} --관리일련번호
GROUP BY QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM, D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO ORDER BY QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO ) --WITH문 , TEMP2 AS ( SELECT C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM --설문지채점영역명 , MAX((CASE WHEN A.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' THEN ROUND(D.GRDNG_SCORE,2) END)) AS BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG --사전설문점수 , MAX((CASE WHEN A.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' THEN ROUND(D.GRDNG_SCORE,2) END)) AS AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG --사후설문점수 ,D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --설문지채점영역관리번호
FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT AA.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AA.REG_YMD DESC, AA.MNG_SN DESC) AS ROW_NUM FROM (SELECT * FROM SBB600 WHERE INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND REG_YMD = #{REG_YMD} AND MNG_SN = #{MNG_SN} ) BB INNER JOIN SBB600 AA ON AA.TRPR_INFO_NO = BB.TRPR_INFO_NO AND AA.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = CASE WHEN BB.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' THEN ( SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 = BB.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO) END AND AA.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' LEFT JOIN SBB500 CC ON AA.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = CC.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND AA.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = CC.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND CC.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = AA.QUSTNB_MNG_NO)
WHERE CC.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO IS NOT NULL ) WHERE ROW_NUM < 2 ) A INNER JOIN SBB500 B /*설문응답 테이블*/ ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 AND B.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) INNER JOIN SBB130 C /*채점영역설정 테이블*/ ON C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿 관리번호 INNER JOIN SBB510 D /*채점결과 테이블*/ ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 AND B.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO --설문응답관리번호 AND C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --설문지채점영역관리번호
GROUP BY QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM, D.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO ORDER BY QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO )
--WITH문 끝 SELECT A.* , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUM FROM ( SELECT '평균' AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM --설문지채점영역명(평균) , ROUND(AVG(NVL(TEMP1.BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG, TEMP2.BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG)),2) AS BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG --사전설문점수 , ROUND(AVG(NVL(TEMP1.AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG, TEMP2.AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG)),2) AS AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG --사후설문점수 FROM TEMP1 LEFT JOIN TEMP2 ON TEMP1.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM = TEMP2.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , B.BEFFAT_SCORE , B.AFTFCT_SCORE FROM TEMP1 A INNER JOIN( SELECT A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , MAX(A.BEFFAT_SCORE) AS BEFFAT_SCORE , MAX(A.AFTFCT_SCORE) AS AFTFCT_SCORE
FROM( SELECT A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , NVL(A.BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG, 0) AS BEFFAT_SCORE , NVL(A.AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG, 0) AS AFTFCT_SCORE FROM TEMP1 A
UNION
SELECT A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , NVL(A.BEFFAT_SCORE_AVG, 0) AS BEFFAT_SCORE , NVL(A.AFTFCT_SCORE_AVG, 0) AS AFTFCT_SCORE FROM TEMP2 A )A GROUP BY QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ) B ON A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM = B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ORDER BY A.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO ) ) A

/*SQL-ID : isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper insertQustnbTrprInfo : 설문대상자(SBB110) 정보 */
INSERT INTO SBB110 ( QUSTNB_MNG_NO /* 설문지관리번호 */ ,QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO /* 설문지템플릿관리번호 */ ,CASE_MNG_NO ,CASE_MNG_ODRNO ,TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ ,APLY_RCPT_SN /* 신청접수일련번호 */ ,TRPR_REL_SE_CD /* 대상자관계구분코드 */ ,FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ ,FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ ,LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ ,LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO} /* 설문지관리번호 */ ,#{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO} /* 설문지템플릿관리번호 */ ,#{CASE_MNG_NO} ,#{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} ,#{TRPR_INFO_NO} /* 대상자정보번호 */ ,#{APLY_RCPT_SN} /* 신청접수일련번호 */ ,#{TRPR_REL_CD} /* 대상자관계구분코드 */ ,#{FRST_RGTR_ID} /* 최초등록자아이디 */ ,SYSDATE /* 최초등록일시 */ ,#{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ ,SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ )

SELECT NVL(MAX(MNG_SN)+1 ,1) FROM SBB600 WHERE INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND REG_YMD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
/*SQL-ID : isry.csemd.sysmng.srvymng.mapper.SrvyMngMapper insertQustnbSndngHstr : 설문발송이력 SBB600 */
INSERT INTO SBB600 ( INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ ,REG_YMD /* 등록일자 */ ,MNG_SN /* 관리일련번호 */ ,UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ ,SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ ,TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ ,APLY_RCPT_SN /* 신청접수일련번호 */ ,TRPR_REL_SE_CD /* 대상자관계구분코드 */ ,QUSTNB_MNG_NO /* 설문지관리번호 */ ,QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO /* 설문지템플릿관리번호 */ ,SRVY_ERA_SE_CD /* 설문시기구분코드 */ ,NO_INPT_SNDNG_YN /* 번호입력발송여부 */ ,SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT /* 설문응답자명암호화 */ ,SRVY_RSPNS_RCPTN_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 설문응답수신휴대전화번호암호화 */ ,RSVT_SNDNG_YN /* 예약발송여부 */ ,SNDNG_DT /* 발송일시 */ ,CHRCTR_CN /* 문자내용 */ ,MSSAGE_ESNTAL_NO /* 메세지고유번호 */ ,SRVY_RCPTN_MTHD_SE_CD /* 설문수신방법구분코드 */ ,FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ ,FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ ,LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ ,LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( #{INST_NO}, /* 기관번호 */ TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), /* 등록일자 */ #{MNG_SN}, /* 관리일련번호 */ #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}, /* 단위업무구분코드 */ #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO}, /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ #{TRPR_INFO_NO}, /* 대상자정보번호 */ #{APLY_RCPT_SN}, /* 신청접수일련번호 */ #{TRPR_REL_CD}, /* 대상자관계구분코드 */ #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}, /* 설문지관리번호 */ #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}, /* 설문지템플릿관리번호 */ #{SRVY_ERA_SE_CD}, /* 설문시기구분코드 */ #{NO_INPT_SNDNG_YN}, /* 번호입력발송여부 */ ENC_B64(#{SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT}), /* 설문응답자명암호화 */ ENC_B64(#{SRVY_RSPNS_RCPTN_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT}), /* 설문응답수신휴대전화번호암호화 */ #{RSVT_SNDNG_YN}, /* 예약발송여부 */
TO_DATE(#{SNDNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), /*발송일시*/
SYSDATE,
#{CHRCTR_CN}, /* 문자내용 */ #{MSSAGE_ESNTAL_NO}, /* 메세지고유번호 */ #{SRVY_RCPTN_MTHD_SE_CD}, /* 설문수신방법구분코드 */ #{FRST_RGTR_ID}, /* 최초등록자아이디 */ SYSDATE, /* 최초등록일시 */ #{LAST_MDFR_ID}, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ )
